profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Delta Air Lines | Building AI Agents & LLM Evaluations Systems for Design Systems
profile.summary:
I lead development of AI tooling that brings together AI Engineering, Design Systems, Frontend Engineering, helping one of the worlds largest airlines modernize how it ships software.

Over the past 4 years at Delta Air Lines, Ive moved from building delta.com web apps to leading development of AI initiatives for Deltas design system, working across TypeScript, Python, Angular, React, and AWS. Today I lead the AI agents that help engineers deliver consistent, on-brand web and mobile screens across the company. AI tools are part of how I build every day, and I put just as much care into evaluating where they fall short.

I care about frontend performance, developer experience, and making complex systems, whether a design system, an internal tool, or an AI-powered workflow, feel simple to use.

Always happy to connect and talk about AI Engineering, Software Engineering, or Design Systems.

I'm exploring opportunities across industries where my expertise can make an impact, with a focus on the Tampa Bay and Orlando areas.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I lead development of AI initiatives for Deltas design system, its shared UI components and styles, building AI agents that help engineers deliver consistent, on-brand web and mobile screens.

The agents Ive built take repetitive work off engineers. Mach-1 agent builds web screens from our components, helping teams create new pages and move old ones to the new design. Another lets anyone prototype mobile app screens without waiting on a design file, and others help our team sort issues and review code faster. To make them reliable, I gave them a way to look up the right components and built a scoring system that compares AI models and improves their output over time.

Beyond agents, I share what I learn about building and evaluating agents with other AI teams at Delta.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I joined Delta building delta.com web apps that let travelers view their trips, check flight status and upload travel documents.

As a founding engineer on Deltas design system, I helped build the shared component libraries teams use to create pages faster in any framework. I paired with designers to close gaps in their guidelines, built the docs site that points both people and AI coding tools to our components, and mentored developers on using them.

I also moved Deltas AI site search to Amazon Bedrock with live answers on delta.com, and built a dashboard that showed stakeholders what customers search for most. When Flight Statuss old in-house server was retiring, I moved it to AWS, keeping flight notifications reliable for travelers.

positions.title: Coding Apprentice - Web Development
positions.description: I collaborated with small teams to design and ship three full-stack applications from Figma through production. I co-built Tranquil using Node.js, Express, and EJS, delivering an MVP in 10 days. I independently built a full-stack ecommerce app using React, Node.js, and MySQL hosted on AWS RDS. I also led UI/UX design and frontend development on QuickByte, presenting to Red Ventures and Road to Hire stakeholders and earning recognition for responsive design and frontend best practices.

positions.title: Email Builder / HTML Email Developer
positions.description: Planned, designed, and delivered 70+ promotional emails across all 50 destinations, maintaining click and open rates above 30%. Created 20+ unique layouts and subject lines for seasonal, loyalty, VIP, and event campaigns, using Salesforce A/B testing to boost engagement and drive revenue. Developed emails with HTML, CSS, and AMPScript, ensuring brand consistency and cross-client compatibility through Litmus testing.

positions.title: Web Builder and Content Editor
positions.description: Designed and developed websites for clients including Rod’s Painting & Remodeling and Things and Stuff, creating clean, user-focused designs to improve online presence and achieve business goals. Optimized sites for SEO and performance, achieving a 90+ Google Lighthouse score, and implemented analytics tools like Facebook Pixel to track traffic and engagement. Built and maintained websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and CMS platforms, delivering functional, visually appealing, and high-performing digital experiences.

positions.title: Inventory Specialist
positions.description: Managed inventory and optimized department space to improve efficiency and drive sales. Gained hands-on knowledge of cars and auto parts, applying it to support daily operations and customer needs.

positions.title: Team Leader
positions.locationName: North Druid Hills, Georgia, United States
positions.description: Delivered consistently positive guest experiences by handling escalated issues and training three new team members to meet customer needs. Maintained clear communication with colleagues to ensure smooth operations and high-quality service.
